headline: FPIs turn net sellers, pull out Rs 35,860 cr in Sep - OrissaPOST
summary: Foreign portfolio investors turned net sellers in September after two months of buying, withdrawing Rs 35,860 crore from Indian equities. Selling continued into October, with another Rs 9,232 crore leaving.
why: Foreign portfolio investors are a major source of liquidity in Indian equities, so their net flows influence index direction.
